name: Codenames Harry Potter
summary: Cooperative Codenames variant where partners exchange one-word clues to find Order of the Phoenix members while avoiding Death Eaters.
rules_text: Two players cooperate with separate sides of a Key card. Each side marks some of 25 Code cards as Order members to find, Ministry Officials as bystanders, and three Death Eaters as assassins. Players alternate as clue giver and guesser. The giver gives a single-word meaning-based clue plus a number. Clues may not refer to spelling, letters, or position, and may not contain or inflect any visible word. The guesser tries to identify that many matching cards. Correct guesses are covered with Order markers. Wrong guesses consume Time-Turner tokens from a time bank to cover the card, costing one token normally and two when Ministry-side tokens are exhausted. Guessing a Death Eater loses instantly. Running out of tokens triggers one sudden-death turn. Win by covering all Order members on both sides. Extra missions vary token counts and allowed mistakes.
rating_reason: Codenames team clue game, hidden roles, text-only turn-based
